ConnectionStrings._comment: Local dev ONLY: connect to the REMOTE production DB on 163.128.34.90 (there is no MySQL on the dev machine). Uses Mysql_admin_User because 'root' is localhost-only on the server and won't accept remote logins. The SERVER (Production) keeps Server=localhost from appsettings.json / appsettings.Production.json — this Development override is never loaded in Production.

BackgroundJobs._comment: Local dev only: OFF so running against production data (claude1) never fires real WhatsApp/email/push. Server (Production) has no override, so jobs default ON.

Database._comment: Local dev only: SkipInit=true bypasses DatabaseInitializer.InitializeAsync() (~900 DDL ops over remote DB — 30-90 sec). Set FALSE when you add a new table or column so the schema gets created/migrated, then flip back to TRUE for fast restarts. Production never reads this — server startup always runs the initializer.

_FrontendUrlComment: Local dev only: club-dues pay/approval/reminder links use FrontendUrl. Point it at localhost so links generated while testing open the LOCAL app (base appsettings.json uses the prod domain).

Media._comment: Local dev only: photos/documents aren't on the local disk, so point reads at the live host. Lets the CMR Word export embed photos and link Agenda/MoM when running locally against prod data. Production leaves this blank (serves from its own WebRoot).

Cmr._comment: Local dev only: set SubmissionEmailOverride to a single address to redirect the CMR-submission email (to DG/AG/President/Secretary) there so testing against prod data never emails the real officers. Blank/absent => real recipients receive it.

MobileApp._comment: Placeholder URLs — replace with real Play Store / App Store links.

RotaryOrgSync._workerNote: Local dev: launches the LOCAL worker exe. NOTE the worker uses its own appsettings.json (Server=localhost) so it may not reach the remote DB from your machine — member-sweep is best tested on the SERVER (Production already has WorkerExePath).

DailyStatsReport._devNote: DEV-ONLY override so a manual Send goes to the tester, not the real recipients. Two identical entries on purpose: config arrays merge by index, so a single entry would leave the base appsettings.json 2nd recipient (naren) as an inherited CC — the duplicate is de-duped at send time, so only this address is emailed. This file is not deployed, so prod keeps mukesh+naren.
